Fast-SCNN
=========

Upstream license: Apache License 2.0
Upstream source: https://github.com/Tramac/Fast-SCNN-pytorch
Pinned revision: 0638517d359ae1664a27dfb2cd1780a40a06c465

Local modifications: OpenScaner retains Fast-SCNN's learning-to-downsample,
global feature extractor, pyramid pooling, feature fusion, and depthwise
classifier topology, changes the classifier to one binary logit, and trains
the complete network on the shared deterministic generated document dataset.
The upstream implementation provides no ImageNet initialization.

The verbatim upstream Apache License 2.0 text is packaged at
licenses/Apache-2.0.txt.
